answer.evidence: This is a 48x64 terrain tile. A speckled dirt ramp runs down the middle between two vertical cliff-edge strips: brown on the left with a dark inner edge, orange on the right. Grass sits only in the top corners (rows 0-3). The ramp itself (rows 0-47) is one continuous texture with no front-edge line or eave shadow, so it reads as a sloped plane or a front-facing surface rather than a distinct top plus front face. Rows 48-63 are flat ground, separated from the ramp by a dark 1-row line at the bottom of the side strips (row 47). The column scan shows only speckle noise (L=120-140) with no band structure. The cliff walls are drawn as flat side strips, not as a top surface plus front face, so the tile fits none of the standard object categories.
